assumptions.statement: 临时总体范围和三个重点片区仅供Agent设计讨论，不是官方红线。
assumptions.impact: 所有面积、比例、长度和项目落位须在官方polygon发布后复算。
assumptions.action: replace geometry; rerun metrics, topology, figures and matrices

assumptions.statement: 缺少法定控规、容积率、高度、道路红线和文保控制。
assumptions.impact: 不提供批准级开发强度和建筑规模。
assumptions.action: establish parcel-level control table and revise massing

assumptions.statement: 建筑图层是概念项目包络，不是现状测绘。
assumptions.impact: 不得据此作拆除、造价或施工判断。
assumptions.trigger: survey, ownership and structural assessment available

assumptions.statement: 未获得电力、给排水、消防、通信、地下管线和轨道接口容量。
assumptions.impact: 端侧算力站与大型活动只能作为条件性建议。
assumptions.action: capacity check and staged engineering design

assumptions.statement: 受托运营体、独立审计和公众参与机制为建议制度，不代表已设立或已授权。
assumptions.impact: 实施前须明确法定主体、预算、责任、保险和监督。
assumptions.action: convert concept charter into approved operating rules
